t: This is Radnor Walk, a quiet residential street off the King's Road, lined with mid and late Victorian houses and part of the Royal Hospital Conservation Area. It was originally Radnor Street, named after John Robartes, 1st Earl of Radnor, who died in Chelsea in 1685. He fought for Parliament in the Civil War. The street was renamed Radnor Walk in 1937. The interior designer and writer Lady Henrietta Spencer-Churchill has lived here.
